maria_cs_ops: Heads-up: multiple accounts got auto-nudges this morning due to duplicate onboarding events. Paused the auto-nudge playbook for new cohorts (48h).

anya_data: I traced it. cs-ingest consumer had a ~35m rebalance window; duplicate first_success events created transient LOW_ENGAGEMENT flags.

sam_sre: confirmed consumer lag and restart. logs: [02:28] WARN partition lag 92k -> [02:35] INFO consumer restarted -> [02:36] INFO lag drained.

devon_cs: some emails already went out. Can we suppress future runs and mark affected accounts so CS doesn't double-reach?

playbook-runner-bot: suppression applied (id=supp-20260325-03). Paused runs for cohorts: new_accounts_48h, trial_starters_7d.

anya_data: exported recipients (~2.1k rows). Dropping CSV to #cs-ops-asana. SQL run: SELECT account_id,email,sent_at FROM outbound_events WHERE event_type='onboard_nudge' AND sent_at BETWEEN to_timestamp(1833334200) AND to_timestamp(1833334500);

lucas_product: short-term: scorer debounce to ignore state flips shorter than 10m. Long-term: playbook-runner should consult source-stability signals before firing auto workflows.

sam_sre: added alert: page if cs-ingest-consumer lag > 30k for >10m and auto-suppress playbooks. Also added suppression API call for the affected window with meta reason.

devon_cs: tagging accounts with suppress_auto_nudge so further automations skip them. I'll draft an outreach note for accidental nudges.

maria_cs_ops: action items: anya PR for debounce + tests, lucas update playbook policy to respect stability flag, sam keep alerting/runbook, devon handle outreach. No backfills until debounce validated. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
